description: Official government updates in one list: US Federal Register rules, proposed rules (with comment deadlines) and notices, SEC press releases, GOV.UK news, guidance and consultations, European Commission press releases, Indian regulators (RBI, SEBI, TRAI, CERC, CDSCO, DGFT) circulars, orders and notifications, plus any RSS feed or official "What's new" list page you name. Filter by sector, keyword, authority and type; every update is tagged with its sectors. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/gov-radar on your Apify account (about $0.003 per update; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

feed_urls.description: Extra RSS/Atom feeds to read with the same filters.

keywords.description: Words or phrases matched on title and summary, e.g. "AI", "stablecoin", "battery".

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 30, max 500). Cost scales with this.

page_urls.description: Official list pages (circulars, notifications, "What's new") to read like a feed; robots.txt is respected.

posted_within_days.description: Only updates from the last N days.

types.description: Update types, e.g. rule, proposed-rule, notice, guidance, consultation, circular, press-release.

name: search_gov_updates

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Search official government updates
